arguments.root_cause_statement: The fraud-scoring Deployment's pod template asks for 512 whole CPU cores. Kubernetes reads an unsuffixed "512" as 512 cores, not 512 millicores; the only node in this cluster has 6 allocatable CPUs, so the scheduler can never place the pod and it stays Pending with FailedScheduling / "Insufficient cpu". Because no pod is ever scheduled, the deployment stays at 0/1 ready and no fraud scores are produced. The fix is to change the request to 512m (or another value that fits within node allocatable CPU) in the Deployment pod template; the pod itself is disposable and will be recreated by the ReplicaSet.
arguments.mechanism: Deployment fraud/fraud-scoring sets .spec.template.spec.containers[scorer].resources.requests.cpu to "512", which Kubernetes interprets as 512 whole cores rather than the intended "512m"; the cluster's single node has cpu=6 allocatable, so the scheduler rejects the pod with FailedScheduling "0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient cpu" and it stays Pending, unscheduled.

evidence.claim: The paged deployment has no ready replicas and its only pod is Pending and unscheduled.
The scheduler cannot place the pod due to insufficient CPU.
evidence.quote: Warning  FailedScheduling  1s    default-scheduler  0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient cpu.

evidence.claim: The pod requests 512 CPU (cores, not millicores).
The only node in the cluster has 6 allocatable CPUs, far below the 512 requested.
The Deployment pod template itself carries the bad CPU request, so recreating the pod cannot help.

ruled_out.alternative: Node is unavailable, tainted or NotReady, preventing scheduling
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The single node is Ready and reports no taints, so the only scheduling obstacle is the CPU request size.

ruled_out.alternative: Pod is failing on a missing image, config, secret or service account reference
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The pod never got scheduled at all - its only condition is PodScheduled=False with no container-level waiting reason - so no reference resolution ever occurred.

ruled_out.alternative: A Service selector mismatch or missing endpoints is the cause of missing scores
ruled_out.ruling_claim: The fraud namespace contains no Service objects at all; only a configmap and serviceaccount accompany the deployment and its pod.
